transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to run the package-lock routine on the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery package before I give my final approval. The current draft lists worldwide delivery, our standard music credit, a 4K UHD 24 fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release. I need signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity — please each report any required changes you're aware of so we can settle this package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning and there are two required changes: the territory must be changed from worldwide to United States and Canada only, and the music credit must be exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs.' I haven't entered the countersigned terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open, but these terms are confirmed and binding.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The draft 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file will fail the partner's ingest specification. I've kept the result in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for 'Midnight Arcade' is embargoed until June 21. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. The approval email is still attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, which is why the draft still shows June 14. The required change from publicity is that the publicity release date must be updated from June 14 to June 21.
